GitHub needs `github_access`, which proves you may push to it; GitLab and Codeberg need a connection (`providers.oauth.start`). Anyone who can write here can then push there through Cobalt, and the provider's branch protection still applies. Pull requests, issues and releases follow, read-only. Naturally idempotent like `repos.create`.
